datasetVersion: Computed with transterm_hp_v2.09.zip (sha256 b636db1c0fe9..., server Last-Modified 2011-02-28; the binary prints 'TransTermHP v2.08'), bundled expterm.dat, default search parameters, --min-conf=76; genome and genes from the NC_000913.3 GenBank file (LOCUS date 09-DEC-2025)

notes: Kept only TransTermHP candidates with confidence >= 76: 6920 of 8780 candidates in TransTermHP's default genomic context were below the cutoff. Candidates TransTermHP suppresses by default as out of context (84782 with --all-context vs 8780 without, both at confidence >= 0) are not included. Overlapping alternatives: TransTermHP often reports several alternative hairpins for one terminator; same-strand candidates whose hairpins overlap were collapsed to one record per locus, keeping the highest confidence, then the narrowest hairpin, then the lowest start (1860 candidates -> 1441 records, 419 alternatives dropped). No measured 3' end exists for a prediction, so terminationBp is not set. Not kept in records.json (reproducible from the build script and cache): TransTermHP's context code, hairpin and tail scores, gap count, TERM label, all sequence text and the overlap notes. Gene input: 127 pseudogene-only gene features with no CDS or RNA feature were not given to TransTermHP. No RegulonDB, EcoCyc or other curated terminator data is used anywhere in this source.
